verses.1: May David be delivered! May the words of Jehovah be fulfilled. You have known me well.
verses.2: You know that I rest in sleep, but I rise to fight against my enemies from afar.
verses.3: My hosts and my friends were all gone, and all my paths were blocked.
verses.4: For there is no difference between them; Jehovah knows all of them.
verses.5: First and foremost, you afflicted me, and your burden weighed heavily on me.
verses.6: My wisdom was shattered by this; it could no longer function.
verses.7: I will go away from your presence, and I will flee from your face.
verses.8: If I ascend to heaven there, then you shall be with me, and I will offer sacrifices to you.
verses.9: I will spread my black wings, and I will settle in the aftermath of the sea.
verses.10: There, your hand will hold me and grasp me with your right hand.
verses.11: And he said, “Let darkness cover me, but let light shine upon me at night.”
verses.12: Even darkness will not be able to hide you from me. And the night will shine like day, because of your light.
verses.13: For you have purchased my goods; please help me carry them on your back.
verses.14: O God, for the sake of your wonders, I fall down in worship. Your deeds are wonderful, and my soul knows this well.
verses.15: I will not be ashamed of you, for I have done what I did in the tomb. I was buried in the depths of the earth.
verses.16: Galmi: Your eyes have seen it all. Everything written in your books has been recorded by days of creation. And among those days, there’s only one that matters.
verses.17: And what do your enemies value? What do their own leaders really value?
verses.18: I have recorded them from the days of Yirban. I will still be with you.
verses.19: If you kill the wicked and those who are evil, then let them be punished by me.
verses.20: When you say it at the right time, it will bring you peace.
verses.21: May the LORD not reject you; may He not abandon you or destroy you.
verses.22: I hated those who hated their enemies.
verses.23: Know me well, and understand my heart through my actions.
verses.24: And see if there is a path of sorrow in me, and whether I will be left in a path of eternal darkness.
